title: Provider
description: Canonical Provider contract per DEVOS-SPEC-024. A Provider is a replaceable implementation of one capability category. Consumers address capabilities, never vendors. Credentials are Secret references only; inline values are invalid.

capability.description: The open capability category this Provider implements, addressed per DEVOS-SPEC-039 for AI capability.

configuration.description: Declarative Provider configuration block. Credential material MUST appear here only as Secret references, never as inline values per DEVOS-SPEC-024.

operations.description: Declared supported operations within the category. Undeclared operations are rejected at invocation time.

credentialSecretRef.description: Identifier of a Secret owned by the same Workspace, resolved transiently by the Security Engine at use time.

healthHints.description: Hints consumed during health evaluation of DEVOS-SPEC-046.
